quality_notes: F01: OpenArt's blue ink motif thread breaks the top frame border and spills into the page margin above the illustration box. HF's version keeps it inside the frame, rising cleanly from the horizon city notch as the prompt specifies.

F06: OpenArt collapsed the 2-line stacked caption (caption_lines: 'a greater than Solomon' / 'is here') into one line and added quotation marks not present in the prompt. HF rendered the exact 2-line stack with no quote marks, matching the spec literally.
Both providers nailed the structural requirements: title, frame number, 3 circled panels, single main scene, caption, corner note, no stray text.
Jesus character consistency from jesus_ref.png held up well on both -- same hair part, beard, robe colors -- no drift observed.
